description: This Java class 'ConnectivityCachingSignalEnrichmentProvider' provides a connectivity service for signal-enriching facades that utilizes an asynchronous Caffeine cache to load additional data for enrichment. It extends 'ConnectivitySignalEnrichmentProvider' and initializes a 'CachingSignalEnrichmentFacade' with configuration and an actor system, offering access via 'getFacade()'.

classes.name: ConnectivityCachingSignalEnrichmentProvider
classes.description: A final class that extends ConnectivitySignalEnrichmentProvider, providing a cached signal enrichment facade using an async cache and actor system configuration.

methods.name: ConnectivityCachingSignalEnrichmentProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the caching signal enrichment facade with configurations and dependencies, intended to be instantiated via reflection.

parameters.name: actorSystem
parameters.description: The actor system used for dispatching cache loader tasks.

methods.name: getFacade
methods.description: Returns the cached SignalEnrichmentFacade instance for a given ConnectionId.
